calls.video_title: Massive Update for Home Depot Stock Investors | HD Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: Upgrading to a buying opportunity (first time in ~2 years): top-tier management through 7 tough years, fwd P/E at multi-year low, fair-to-slightly-undervalued after ~30% selloff; dollar-cost average in as macro improves
calls.base: Fair value $263 vs $286 market (~8% below intrinsic, within his 5-10% margin of safety); ROIC 18.5% still ~2x WACC; margins 12.4%
calls.bull: Economy rebounds in 3-6 months on low unemployment + AI capex boom; home improvement spending recovers; management compounds excellently
calls.bear: Near-term macro headwinds (higher oil, lower disposable income) keep pressure on consumer/home-improvement spending for months
calls.flip_note: First tracked HD call on record; he says he warned against buying for 1.5-2 years, so this is an upgrade in his narrative
